title: Base change for extension by zero
statement:
In the situation of [def-sfb-dc-open-base-change-morphism], assume that the square is
cartesian, i.e. $X'=X\times_ZZ'=g^{-1}(X)$. Then the exchange morphism
$\mathrm{Ex}^{j}_{sq}\colon j'_!\circ Lg'^*\to Lg^*\circ j_!$ is an isomorphism, for every
commutative condensed ring $\Lambda$.

proof.text: Apply the cartesian extension-by-zero left-inverse subclaim to obtain a morphism β whose composite with the exchange morphism is the identity.

Apply the corresponding right-inverse subclaim to obtain γ. Associativity and the two inverse equations identify β and γ, and CategoryTheory.IsIso.mk constructs the IsIso instance for the exchange morphism.

proof_origin.place: Stage 3 proof: assemble the two inverse equations with CategoryTheory.IsIso.mk
